authorization_reference: Latest direct user instruction: PPIKB 2099 noncanonical Kd candidates, standard controls, separate non-natural and PTM evaluation, strict splits, independent external validation, at least five predecessor papers, all ten seeds, no novel model.
notes: Method identity, splits, training regimes and target denominators are deliberately empty until independently supplied.
2099 is an input-candidate count, not a predeclared count surviving strict scope and split QC.
Non-natural and PTM are separate primary strata; mixed chemistry must not be silently assigned to both denominators.
A model lacking verified noncanonical encoding must report unsupported coverage rather than substitute unknown residues as standard amino acids.
No PepLand original or derivative binding records may be added to this campaign.
